verified_findings.story_title: TCC introduces an optional AI documentation assistant with patient-choice and provider-review boundaries

primary_source.author: Institutional article; HTML author metadata points to /author/rachel-reilly/, with no individual byline in extracted article text.
primary_source.retrieval: web.open failed; curl -fsSL succeeded repeatedly. Parsed complete article and separately checked HTML publication metadata.
primary_source.source_type: First-party institutional announcement, not independent effectiveness or privacy audit. WordPress publishing format alone does not make this an opinion source.

background_source.supported_context: Alaska Native nonprofit and Interior Alaska tribal consortium; 42 members, including 39 villages and 37 federally recognized tribes. These are organization counts, not Sully rollout counts.

supported_facts: TCC announced it is introducing Sully.ai for visit documentation.
Patient permission precedes recording; patients can decline or change their mind without care being affected.
The tool drafts notes; the provider reviews, edits when necessary and approves before chart inclusion.
TCC assigns clinical responsibility to providers and excludes diagnosis, treatment recommendations and medical decisions from this tool's role.
TCC says recordings have secure storage, HIPAA protection and deletion after 90 days.
TCC discloses possible company reuse of de-identified recording portions to improve the system.

quote_check.text: Choosing not to use Sully.ai will not affect the care you receive.

required_caveats: Attribute privacy and benefit assertions to TCC, not independent verification.
Retention disclosure concerns recordings; it does not specify deletion of chart notes, derivatives or model training effects.
Withdrawal is stated, but retroactive deletion, undoing prior reuse, and separate reuse consent are unspecified.
No rollout counts, operational dates, model architecture, measured benefits, error rates or patient sentiment are established.
Do not infer successful de-identification or guaranteed anonymity.

deployment_wording.approved: TCC announced it is introducing Sully.ai.
reject: Deletes all patient data after 90 days
deployment_wording.researcher_correction: Replace deployment announcement with introduction announcement; no completed rollout was verified.

verified_findings.honest_ai_mechanism: Audio-to-draft documentation with human approval, not autonomous care.
verified_findings.confidence: high for publication and stated institutional terms; unverified for implementation and outcomes
verified_findings.sourcing_rule_reason: One independently fetched primary institutional announcement is sufficient.
